description: This file defines the TbActorMailbox class, which manages message queuing, processing, and actor lifecycle control within an actor system, including initialization, message handling, failure strategies, and actor destruction.

classes.name: TbActorMailbox
classes.description: Manages message queues and actor lifecycle, including initialization, message processing, failure handling, and destruction within an actor system.

methods.name: tryInit
methods.description: Attempts to initialize the actor, with retry logic based on failure strategies.

methods.name: isUnrecoverable
methods.description: Determines if an exception is unrecoverable based on RecoveryAware interface.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a message to the high or normal priority queue and triggers processing.

methods.name: tryProcessQueue
methods.description: Checks if the mailbox is ready and not busy, then schedules message processing.

methods.name: processMailbox
methods.description: Processes messages up to the throughput limit, handling exceptions and message failures.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Stops the actor, clears message queues, and marks the mailbox as not ready.
